title: On Venus, a Day Is Longer Than a Year 🪐 #shorts
description:
Venus spins once in about 243 Earth days, but circles the Sun in only about 225. So a day on Venus is longer than its year! It also spins backwards, so the Sun rises in the west, and its surface is about 465°C – hot enough to melt lead.

Sources: NASA Science, Britannica

#shorts #facts #crazyfacts #space #didyouknow #venus
comment: If you could visit one planet, which would it be? 👇

scenes.text: On Venus, one day lasts longer than one year.
scenes.headline:
VENUS DAY
IS LONGER
THAN ITS YEAR

scenes.text: Venus is the second planet from the Sun, and almost the same size as Earth.
It spins incredibly slowly. One full turn takes about 243 Earth days.
scenes.label: ONE SPIN OF VENUS

scenes.text: But it circles the Sun in only about 225 Earth days.
So Venus finishes a whole year before it finishes a single spin!
It also spins backwards, so on Venus the Sun rises in the west.
And the surface is about 465 degrees Celsius, hot enough to melt lead.
